gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: The updates have resulted in ultimate gross reserves of GBP 393.4m, GBP 113.8m net of reinsurance (31 December 2023 - GBP 264.5m gross, GBP 84.5m net of reinsurance) as at 31 December 2024. The casualty business group experienced deterioration to the prior year reserves as a result of construction defect claims in Florida. The syndicate has seen an increase in the frequency of lawsuits relating to issues on its Florida based contractors book arising from construction defects. Due to the continued adverse development seen during the year additional gross reserves of GBP 52.7m and GBP 52.3m net of reinsurance were recorded bringing the overall gross reserves for this class to GBP 132.0m (2023 - GBP 79.4m) and net reserves to GBP 131.3m (2023GBP 79.0m). As a result of the adverse prior year loss development arising from the Russia/Ukraine losses and the Artisans sub class, the 2021 year of account is in a cumulative loss as at 31 December 2024.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2024 the syndicate's prioryears reserves showed material adverse development. Using the gross claims development triangle (UW years 2015-2022) the estimated prioryear strengthening amounts to approximately GBP 194.6m (c.15.1% of opening gross claims outstanding). Key contributors were the westernleased aircraft (Russia) exposures (material uplift), adverse development on the US contractors/general liability (construction defect) book, and a series of catastrophe and large losses (including the Dali bridge collapse and US hurricanes). These movements have driven the decision to keep the 2021 year of account open while uncertainty persists.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prioryear development (GBP 194.623m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (see claims development note) by summing changes in current estimates for UW years 2015-2022 (triangle presented in GBP '000). The 2021 year of account remains open and a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) was executed on 13 January 2025 (postbalance sheet) which will affect runoff of certain discontinued portfolios; that transaction postdates the 31/12/2024 statements and is not reflected in the figures above. Where the report quotes gross movements explicitly (e.g. +GBP 52.7m for contractors), those were used to map to LOBs. Some event amounts are reported gross or net in different places; figures given here follow the report's stated gross amounts where available. Confidence levels reflect whether amounts are explicitly stated (1.0), computed from tables/triangles (0.8), or inferred/unspecified (0.5).
